decision: Whether a free-form tool-using teacher merits an explicitly experimental opt-in alongside the authored local teacher

judge.sameFamilyLimit: Separate judge calls and prompts do not make GPT-OSS model errors independent.

evaluation.unit: Musical context; repeated trials are correlated observations
evaluation.fixedHistory: Identical observable histories; expected goals and forbidden claims, not an exact next action
evaluation.episodes: Conditional scripted learner responses test orchestration, not learning
evaluation.scoring: Deterministic structural criteria and separately qualified free-prose judges
evaluation.missing: Retain all started failures; unstarted arms unavailable; planned denominators and coverage always shown
evaluation.latency: Actual actor and judge execution separate from replay

forge.lens: Actual SDK model/tool/validation spans with lesson and turn correlation
forge.weave: Recorded-output replay with deterministic and model-judge criteria separate
forge.models: Static campaign accounting only; no invented training curve
forge.registry: No new model artifact without actual justified training

privacy.allowed: Authored dialogue, normalized original musical examples, synthetic attempt summaries, versioned outputs and scores

stopRules: Unqualified judge used as release evidence
